About Us
 ACTIVE TECHNICAL SERVICES LTD was registered on 18 th October, 2023 as a
 limited liability company under the Companies act, 2002 of the laws of
 Tanzania with the certiﬁcate Number 169422168.

 The company is also registered with the Tanzania Revenue Authority under the
 TIN 169-422-168.There by making it legally recognized company andauthorised
 to operated in its ﬁeld of speciality as speciﬁed in the companies memorandum
 and article of association.


Administration
 The Company was founded under a joint body by two directors;
 Nyeko Francis and Adolf Serete .
 NYEKO FRANCIS:
 Currently the head of Directors with a lot of knowledge and experience in the
 ﬁled of Engineering speciﬁcally Civil and Mechanical . He is also actively involved
 in Lobbying for Contracts , General management and administration.

 ADOLF SERETE:
 He is a technical director with an immense level of experience in the technical
 aspect that involves analysing all technical drawings and actively involve in the
 technical ﬁeld.

Core Values
 In order to achieve the vision, the company shares the following core values.
 - Accountability.
 - Integrity.
 - Transparency.
 - Diligence.
 - Team Spirit.
 - Loyalty.
 - Eﬃciency.

4
Our Mission
- Developing and operating a ﬁnancially sound enterprise with proﬁtable growth.
- To support our clients to achieve success by acting as their trusted service
  providers.
- To provide quality, cost eﬀective, personalized and innovative service to meet
   the changing needs of our clients.
- To empower our manpower through continuous professional developments to
  face the dynamic challenges.

5

 Our Philosophy
- We are committed to promote high standards of discipline and excellence to
  aﬃrm quality standards and values.
- We are dedicated to maintain a strong internal administration, thereby enabling
  provision of quality services and ensure client satisfaction.
- At ACTIVE TECHNICAL SERVICES LTD a ‘Customer is a King’ and strongly believe that
  good relationships with our customers are a prerequisite to our success.

Products / Services.
 The company majors in provision of quality services in the area of 7
 - Labour Supply
 - Welding & Fabrication
 - Structural Works
 - Insulation (Lagging)
 - Plant Installation which include Machines, Pipe works and Maintenance.
 The company also provide skilled and semi skilled man power at a market
 friendly price.
 -The company also does commissioning after the work is done.

Production
 We oﬀer ﬁrst class production and our workmanship is of high quality.
 In order to accomplish and produce quality work we have been able to install
 state of the equipment.

 The company also formed a structure of four departments so as to realize
 eﬀective service to the clients.

 1. Technical service.
 2. Finance and logistics.
 3. Human resource and administration.
 4. Legal aﬀairs.

 The company believes that to obtain maximum production from its personnel,
 their health and safety must be of a great paramount. However, this can only be
 achieved when the overall working environment is conducive.

 The company prepare programs to its personnel in which they get relevant
 information and are introduced to new tools and equipments that quarante
 a safe and healthy working environment which led to high production in the
 shortest period of time.
